results.title: anthropic_sdk::caching - Rust
results.content: Prompt caching lets you reuse a previously processed prefix of a prompt across requests. In this crate the cache is controlled per content block via CacheControl::Ephemeral, which marks the block and everything before it as cacheable for five minutes.

results.title: Support for prompt caching · Discussion #412 · 64bit/async-openai
results.content: Opening a discussion on how we should surface cached_tokens from the usage object. Right now the struct drops the field entirely, so a caller has no way to tell a cache hit from a cold request, and the billing difference between the two is roughly ten to one. My proposal is to add a CompletionUsageDetails struct behind a non_exhaustive attribute so we can extend it as OpenAI adds fields, mirroring what we already do for the streaming delta types, and then thread it through the client's response mapping without breaking the existing public signature for anybody currently matching on Usage.
